notes:
-- Account overview:
Solstice GeoIntel Labs is an EU-headquartered geospatial analytics vendor supporting maritime safety and regulatory reporting for EU/UK/Canada/APAC customers. Heavy use of vector search over classified doc corpora + occasional LLM summarization for compliance reports. Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for stronger data residency and audit controls.

-- Key asks from security/compliance (direct quotes):
- 'We must ensure all training/inputs never leave jurisdiction and logs are export-controlled.' (Head of Legal)
- 'KMS integration has to support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS or HSM) and key rotation policies.' (SecOps)

-- Residency specifics requested:
- EU-only tenant (FR/DE/NL) for EU clients; separate UK sovereign zone for UK customers; Canadian zone (ON) for federal contracts; APAC node (Singapore) for SEA pilots.
- Retention: audit logs 7 years for select customers; ability to export tamper-evident logs to customer archive.

-- Operational constraints:
- Latency requirement for vector search p50 < 120ms for 512-dim embeddings, sustained throughput 2500 qps during peak windows.
- Summarization jobs run as batch nightly with tolerance for higher latency but require deterministic model variants for auditability.
- Cost sensitivity moderate; willing to pay premium for strong guarantees + KMS/HSM and per-country tenancy.

-- Procurement notes / redlines:
- Need residency and audit logging clause added to Master Services Agreement.
- Insist on SAML SSO integration and SOC2/ISO27001 evidence before go-live.
- Request SLA language for cross-zone failover and clear fallback to lower-capacity model variants.

-- Sales/technical summary for AE/SE:
- SE workshop completed 2026-02-18 (see ff_2026-02-18_07b9). Demo focused on private VPC deployment topology, KMS keyflow, and per-tenant audit logging.
- Proof-of-concept requested: 3-week VPC pilot scoped to EU-FR zone, include KMS integration with customer HSM (test keys), streaming audit events to customer SIEM.
- They asked for an example SOW and a residency addendum - uploaded to drive (Redwood_SOW_DRAFT_v3.docx).

-- Quotes from technical leads:
- 'If we can show per-country tenancy and tamper-evident logs, procurement will move fast.' (CTO)
- 'We need to validate key wrapping with HashiCorp Vault/HSM.' (SecOps)

-- Risk notes:
- Legal team flagged third-party subprocessors list; needs disclosure of cloud infra partners in each region.
- Potential delay: internal architecture board requires independent pen-test of Private VPC image.

-- Short wins to push forward:
- Offer a templated residency addendum and a SOC2 + ISO27001 attestation pack up front.
- Provide a KMS integration runbook and sample Terraform for VPC deployment in EU-FR.
